answer: Proof of stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to lock capital to validate transactions. Much like a velvet rope protecting a private club, this financial barrier ensures that influence scales with assets, not identity count. An attacker attempting to flood the network would need enough nectar of liquidity to secure a majority stake, effectively turning the economic lagoon of the system into a costly moat that renders unauthorized mass-identity creation prohibitively expensive.
